items.title: Cloudflare Fixes Flaw That Let One Container Read Another Customer's Leftover Disk Data

The data came from disk space that earlier containers had used and given up, not from any live workload, and an attacker could not choose whose data they got, according to Cloudflare. The company

items.title: WSO2 and Adobe Commerce Flaws Exploited in Attacks, Added to CISA KEV
items.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), on Thursday, added two critical security flaws impacting WSO2 and Adobe Commerce and Magento to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, based on evidence of active exploitation.
